behavior_summary: Declares the full component surface: 19 activities, 16 services, 29 receivers, 6 providers, 52 permissions; AccessibilityService + VpnService dual enforcement; no DeviceAdmin.
description: 326-line manifest for com.pt.bark v7.26.0 proving single-APK child-enforcement topology: exported BarkAccessibilityService and BarkVpnService (SUPPORTS_ALWAYS_ON), exported DeviceCodeActivity with barkuninstall://uninstall deep link, signature-protected ContactApprovalPolicyReceiver, directBootAware RebootReceiver, 52 permissions incl. SMS/MMS/contacts/browser-history/background-location and us.bark.guarddog.permission.INVALIDATE_SCAMS.
name: Manifest Foundation (Single-APK Child Agent)

reusability_assessment.notes: Reference for single-APK child agent component layout; do not copy hardcoded keys/DSN.

behavior_summary: Classifies a bitmap as abusive/safe with a singleton ORT session; silent null on failure.
description: On-device adult/explicit image classifier: ORTAnalyzer (singleton) loads adultmediamobile_31_1724800699_fp32.ort (16.1MB .ort), scales to 224x224, applies ImageNet normalization into float[1][3][224][224], runs ai.onnxruntime session, tempered-softmax (T=1.5) over float[1][2], abusive iff scores[1] >= 0.98.
name: ONNX Image Classifier (Adult/Explicit Media)

reusability_assessment.notes: Copy the pattern (session lifecycle, preprocessing, thresholds, silent failure); train/ship own model weights.

behavior_summary: Maps input text to the highest-probability scam label; returns null when nothing crosses the threshold.
description: On-device scam text classifier: TextAnalyzer loads mobilemodel_1_1753905899.ort (16.8MB .ort), classifies into 12 labels (11 scam types + neutral), returns the first non-neutral label with probability >= 0.97. No callers inside this APK — executed by the companion us.bark.guarddog app via scam broadcasts.
name: ONNX Text Scam Classifier (12 Labels)

reusability_assessment.notes: Highest-value reuse: extend label set + Arabic tokenizer/vocab for Family OS scam/abusiveness detection.

behavior_summary: Scores an inbound short-code SMS as Spam/Legit; tiny model suited to low-end devices.
description: OTP/short-code spam classifier: OTPClassifier (singleton) loads mfaondevice_1_1234567890.onnx (49KB), vectorizes cleaned text with TFIDFVectorizer (sklearn-style tfidf_config.json: vocabulary, idf_weights, ngram_range, sublinear_tf, norm, smooth_idf), runs float[1 x numFeatures] -> float[1][2], Spam iff output[0][1] >= 0.5.
name: OTP Short-Code Spam Classifier (TF-IDF + ONNX)

reusability_assessment.notes: Copy for SMS-phishing detection; retrain TF-IDF on Arabic short codes.

behavior_summary: Converts raw text into the 3-tensor BERT-style input the scam model expects.
description: Text preprocessing + tokenization pipeline: TokenizationManager strips non-[a-zA-Z0-9] and lowercases (English-only), HuggingFaceTokenizer loads tokenizer.json/tokenizer_config.json/special_tokens_map.json from res/raw (whitespace split, vocab/[UNK] fallback, cls/sep tokens), emits inputIds/attentionMask/tokenTypeIds padded to 512; TextClassificationEngine maps 3 long[1][seqLen] tensors by input name and applies softmax.
name: HuggingFace Tokenizer + Text Preprocessing Pipeline

reusability_assessment.notes: Reuse pipeline shape; replace tokenizer assets with Arabic-capable ones (current is English-only).

behavior_summary: Decides which on-device model runs for a given message/image and formats the versioned score JSON stored in MessagesDB.scores.
description: On-device analysis orchestrator: AnalysisManager.isShortCode heuristic (inbound, non-contact, Bark Phone, short/letter-bearing numbers) gates OTPClassifier.analyzeShortCode; ImageWorker path gates ORTAnalyzer; formats {adult_explicit:{present,score,version,deleted}} and {non_otp_unknown_sms:{abusive,score,version,deleted}} with model version = raw resource entry name; deletion flags from PersistenceManager.
name: On-Device Analysis Orchestrator (AnalysisManager)

reusability_assessment.notes: Copy the orchestrator + JSON schema; adapt short-code heuristics to Yemen/Gulf numbering.

behavior_summary: Routes every accessibility event to the right per-app helper; protects its own settings page; triggers uploads on significant events.
description: BarkAccessibilityService (1816 lines): pre-login Bark Phone events go to GuardDogSetupHelper; blockedUninstall short-circuits; package-name switch dispatches to ~57 *Helper classes (social scrapers, browsers, dialer, settings, package installer...); 'Turn off Bark?' dialog triggers double-BACK + password gate; helper true -> WorkHelper.startUploadWorker. Config: typeAllMask/feedbackAllMask, canPerformGestures, canTakeScreenshot.
name: Accessibility Event Dispatcher (~57 Per-App Helpers)

reusability_assessment.notes: Copy dispatcher + anti-tamper reactions; per-app scrapers are brittle (break on app updates) — secondary layer only.

behavior_summary: Any uninstall/settings-tamper attempt is intercepted and parked behind a 6-digit parent code gate.
description: Anti-uninstall without DeviceAdmin: blockedUninstall (TYPE_VIEW_FOCUSED 'Bark' text + Settings app-info screen) and PackageInstallerHelper (4-text uninstall AlertDialog match incl. Amazon variant) feed a 500ms-throttled observable -> DeviceCodeActivity. PasswordProtectedViewModel.handleVerify: parentId local bypass (offline) or POST password (success or HTTP 402 unlocks); 5-minute unlock window; 5-minute post-install grace period.
name: Device-Code Anti-Uninstall Gate

reusability_assessment.notes: Copy, but close the install-grace hole and add brute-force throttling on the 6-digit code.

behavior_summary: Captures all device traffic in a native tunnel so DNS/firewall policy can be enforced below the app layer.
description: BarkVpnService: VpnService.Builder with 10.50.34.57/32, routes 0.0.0.0/0 + 2000::/3, DNS 1.1.1.1/8.8.8.8/8.8.4.4 (+v6), disallowed self/telephone/mms/Dexcom; hands TUN fd to librltun.so via JNA startCTunnel(tunFd, cacheDir, certBundle, deviceApiKey); native RLTUN::APIClient calls https://screentime.bark.us/api/devices/checkDNS + /heartbeat with DNS/Firewall resolution callbacks; assets/cacert.pem enables TLS interception; SUPPORTS_ALWAYS_ON; VpnReconnectActivity re-prompts consent.
name: VPN Service + RLTUN Native Tunnel (Web Filtering)

reusability_assessment.notes: Reference for network-layer filtering; heavy (native lib + CA MITM) — optional layer in Family OS, DNS-filtering first.

behavior_summary: Every DNS lookup is policy-checked against server-managed firewall rules inside the native tunnel.
description: DNS/firewall verdict path: TunnelFilter.setCheckDNSCallback + APIClient.sendCheckDNS(domain, cb(DNSRequestResolution, FirewallResolution)) against https://screentime.bark.us/api/devices/checkDNS; periodic /api/devices/heartbeat keeps policy fresh. Events (vpnStarted/vpnRevoked as vpn_status_change) go to POST devices/event + devices/eventBatch on the same host.
name: DNS/Firewall Verdict Channel (screentime API)

reusability_assessment.notes: Adopt the verdict-callback shape (allow/block/redirect) for Family OS DNS filtering.

behavior_summary: Parent signs in on the child device once; the device is bound to a child + connection + ScreenTime device key.
description: Pairing flow: SignInActivity POST login -> parent token/parentId; AddChildActivity POST children (name/birthday) -> CreateChildResponse; activateConnection -> POST children/{child_id}/connections/android -> persists connectionId + child JSON; loadDevice -> POST children/{child_id}/devices -> Device{apiKey} for the native tunnel. Exported BootstrapReceiver accepts ACTION_SEND_BOOTSTRAP_CONFIG for fleet provisioning.
name: Device-Code Pairing & Activation Flow

reusability_assessment.notes: Copy the 4-step binding (login->child->connection->device key); keep bootstrap receiver for managed devices.

behavior_summary: Work is split across apps by signed broadcasts: detections out, verdicts/policies in.
description: Companion-app protocol (~50 actions in BarkBroadcasts): ACTION_SMS_SCAM_DETECTED/ACTION_MMS_SCAM_DETECTED -> us.bark.guarddog (runs the text model); ACTION_SCAM_INVALIDATED -> us.bark.messages; ACTION_VPN_STARTED -> guarddog; BARK_ACTION_REQUEST_SHUTDOWN inbound; GuardDogSetupHelper (840 lines) drives Bark Phone onboarding via accessibility before login (usage access, private DNS, battery optimization steps). Permission us.bark.guarddog.permission.INVALIDATE_SCAMS guards the watchdog.
name: GuardDog Companion Protocol (Signed Broadcasts)

reusability_assessment.notes: Model for Family OS multi-app split (monitor vs analyzer) over signature-protected broadcasts.

behavior_summary: SMS/MMS, contacts, browser history, screenshots, media, location and app inventory are collected by 19 WorkManager workers into one queue.
description: Monitoring surface: SmsWorker/MmsWorker + History variants over content://sms (2-month backfill); ChromeBrowserWorker (content://com.android.chrome.browser/bookmarks) + Samsung/Default/Search workers; ImageWorker/VideoWorker + History with on-device explicit-media analysis; ScreenShotService (MediaProjection, 500ms debounce, accessibility-linked); BarkLocationService (foreground location, disabled on Bark Phone); contact-approval policy with QuickShare protection; InventoryWorker for installed apps.
name: Monitoring Surface (19 Workers + Services)

reusability_assessment.notes: Copy the worker-per-source pattern + central UploadWorker; keep history backfill window configurable.

behavior_summary: All collected content lands in one SQLite table with an upload flag; config lives in a single SharedPreferences file.
description: Local store: MessagesDB.MESSAGE_TABLE (authorName, authorNumber, mediaFilepath, message, messageId, provider, recipientName, recipientId, sent, timestamp, scores JSON, type, uploadedToServer, uuid PK); UploadWorker drains uploadedToServer=0. SharedPreferences 'Id' holds token, parentId, child/device JSON, connectionId, feature flags (polling, screen-time, scam/explicit monitoring, require-approved-contacts), geofence IDs, cached events.
name: MessagesDB Local Store + Upload Queue

reusability_assessment.notes: Copy the single-table + scores-column + upload-flag shape as Family OS analysis_results store.

behavior_summary: Three Retrofit hosts cover management, location ingest and screen-time events; auth is a prefixed bearer-style header.
description: REST surface: BarkRestClient ROOT=https://www.bark.us/api/v2/ (BarkApi: 13 endpoints — login, password, versions, children CRUD, connections/android, devices, activities, inventories, logs, events, checkins, locations, places/events), DATA_ROOT=https://data.bark.us/ (POST locations), screentime.bark.us (ScreenTimeApi: devices/event, devices/eventBatch). Retrofit+RxJava+Gson, 60s timeouts, Authorization via buildAuth(token).
name: REST API Surface (v2 + data + screentime)

reusability_assessment.notes: Endpoint inventory is a design reference for Family OS API; do not reuse hosts/auth scheme.

behavior_summary: Push arrives via OneSignal over FCM; crashes/telemetry go to a hardcoded Sentry DSN.
description: Realtime & telemetry: OneSignal (FCMBroadcastReceiver, NotificationServiceExtension customizing notifications, SyncService, BootUpReceiver), Firebase Messaging, Sentry (DSN https://95aa82c111714bf0b18ad5048c7ce0f6@sentry.bark.us/19 hardcoded in manifest, traces.sample-rate=0.01).
name: Push & Crash Telemetry (OneSignal/FCM/Sentry)

reusability_assessment.notes: Standard pattern; DSN must come from server config, never hardcoded.

behavior_summary: The agent survives reboots and task kills via boot receivers, foreground services and VPN auto-restart.
description: Keep-alive package: directBootAware RebootReceiver (BOOT_COMPLETED + LOCKED_BOOT_COMPLETED), foreground services (VPN specialUse, location, mediaProjection) with persistent notifications, onTaskRemoved -> VPN restart, AppUpdateReceiver on MY_PACKAGE_REPLACED, WorkManager periodic workers re-registering themselves.
name: Keep-Alive & Watchdog Package

reusability_assessment.notes: Reference for agent resilience; notification-hiding tricks must stay honest per Play policy.

behavior_summary: Catalog of what Family OS must NOT copy: hardcoded secrets, debug bypass, legacy storage, overbroad backup.
description: Explicitly rejected: hardcoded Google Maps API key + Sentry DSN in manifest, DEBUG_PASSWORD_BYPASS_ENABLED=true in release build, 5-minute post-install uninstall grace period, requestLegacyExternalStorage=true, allowBackup=true, English-only text preprocessing.
name: Security Anti-Patterns Catalog (Explicitly Rejected)

reusability_assessment.notes: Do-not-reuse list; enforced in Family OS code review.
